scope.description: Storage-qualified leader commitment of ordinary current-term entries in fixed simple configurations under asynchronous Ready processing.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine messages and honest FIFO storage workers.
No membership changes during the selected proposal interval.
MemoryStorage is the storage-completion model; completed writes are not lost during these executions.
excluded: Physical disk durability and crash recovery
Global consensus safety or client linearizability conclusions

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No implementation modifications; same-package access reads target index, self Match and applied index only.
MemoryStorage substitutes for durable backend completion. No crash recovery or filesystem durability claim.
Derived booleans compare raw leader commit >= target index and matching persisted replica count >= configured majority. Raw operands are emitted.

plan_uncertainties: Observations cover these fixed schedules and two cluster sizes, not all asynchronous interleavings.
MemoryStorage completion represents the embedding durability promise; actual crash durability is outside this check.
